- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

- Added keyboard and touch controls, platforming, combat, hazards, collectibles, terminals, checkpoints, a boss, and story ending.

Built **VESPER — The Last Signal** in `index.html`: a playable pixel-art space Metroidvania with platforming, combat, hazards, collectibles, terminals, checkpoints, a boss encounter, and a story ending. It includes keyboard and touch controls.

Verified the inline JavaScript syntax and browser console, and captured small JPEG checks, including `screenshots/vesper-final.jpg` and `screenshots/vesper-mobile-play.jpg`. I assumed a self-contained, no-build browser game was the right fit. The changes remain uncommitted.
